name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
text: PM-Kisan mein chhote aur seemant kisan parivaaron ko saal mein 6000 rupaye teen kisto mein seedha bank account mein milte hain. Zameen ke records, Aadhaar aur bank account zaroori hain. Registration pmkisan.gov.in ya CSC centre se hota hai.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
text: Ayushman Bharat se eligible parivaaron ko hospital mein bharti hone par 5 lakh rupaye tak ka muft ilaaj milta hai. Eligibility SECC data ke hisaab se tay hoti hai. Ayushman card ke liye Aadhaar ya ration card le jaake CSC ya empanelled hospital jaao.

name: PM Awas Yojana (PMAY)
text: PMAY mein ghar na rakhne wale ya kaccha ghar wale parivaaron ko pakka ghar banane ya kharidne mein madad milti hai. Gramin aur Shehri dono ke liye alag versions hain. Aadhaar, income proof aur bank details lagte hain.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
text: Ujjwala mein garib parivaar ki mahilaon ko muft LPG connection milta hai. Aavedan mahila ke naam par hota hai, nazdiki LPG distributor ke paas. KYC, ration card aur Aadhaar chahiye.

name: PM Mudra Yojana
text: Mudra Yojana mein chhote vyapaar ya dukaan ke liye bina guarantee loan milta hai. Teen category hain: Shishu, Kishor aur Tarun, alag-alag loan limit ke saath. Bank, NBFC ya MFI se aavedan karte hain. Business plan aur ID proof chahiye.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
text: PMFBY fasal kharab hone par kisan ko bima paisa deti hai. Baadh, sookha, toofan, keede aur beemari se hue nuksaan ka claim milta hai. Kisan ko sirf chhota premium dena hota hai: kharif fasal mein 2%, rabi mein 1.5%, aur bagwani/commercial fasal mein 5%. Baaki premium sarkar bharti hai. Zameen ke maalik, batai par kheti karne wale (sharecropper) aur kiraye par kheti karne wale kisan, sab eligible hain, bas fasal notified ho aur ilaaka notified ho. Aadhaar, bank account, zameen ya lease ke kagaz aur bowai ka praman chahiye. Apply pmfby.gov.in, bank, CSC centre ya bima company ke office se hota hai.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
text: Kisan Credit Card se kisan ko kheti ke kharche (beej, khaad, dawai, majdoori) aur kheti ke saaman ke liye bank se sasta aur jaldi loan milta hai. Ye revolving credit hai, yaani baar-baar loan ke liye aavedan nahi karna padta. Kheti ke saath pashupalan aur machhli palan karne wale bhi KCC le sakte hain. Byaaj aam taur par 7% tak hota hai, aur 3 lakh tak ke short-term crop loan par sarkar byaaj mein chhoot deti hai aur samay par paisa lautane par extra chhoot milti hai, jisse asli byaaj kaafi kam ho jata hai. Limit zameen, fasal aur zaroorat ke hisaab se tay hoti hai. Documents: pehchan patra, pate ka praman, zameen ya batai ke kagaz, photo, aur fasal ki jaankari. Apply nazdiki bank branch se karo.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
text: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana beti ki padhai aur shaadi ke liye lambe samay ki bachat yojana hai. Beti ke naam par uske mata-pita ya legal guardian post office ya bank mein khata kholte hain. Beti ki umar 10 saal se kam honi chahiye. Khata sirf Rs 250 se khul jata hai aur ek saal mein zyada se zyada Rs 1.5 lakh jama kar sakte hain. Byaaj sarkar tay karti hai aur har timahi badal sakta hai; October-December 2026 timahi mein ye 8.2% hai, jo kaafi achha hai. Byaaj aur maturity ki rakam tax-free hai. Documents: beti ka janm praman patra, mata-pita ka Aadhaar/ID aur pate ka praman. Apply nazdiki post office ya authorised bank mein hota hai.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
text: Atal Pension Yojana asangathit kshetra ke mazdooron aur chhote kaam karne walon ke liye budhape ki pension yojana hai. 60 saal ki umar ke baad har mahine Rs 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 ya 5000 ki pakki pension milti hai, jitni aap chunte ho aur jitna jama karte ho. Umar 18 se 40 saal ke beech honi chahiye aur bank ya post office savings account chahiye. Jitni jaldi judoge, utna kam mahine ka kharch: 18 saal mein judne par Rs 5000 pension ke liye lagbhag Rs 210 mahina lagta hai, jabki 40 saal mein lagbhag Rs 1454. Paisa bank account se apne aap kat jata hai. 1 October 2022 se jo vyakti income tax bharta hai ya kabhi bhar chuka hai, wo is yojana mein nahi jud sakta. Aadhaar aur chalu mobile number chahiye. Apply kisi bhi bank ya post office mein form bharke hota hai. Subscriber ki maut par wahi pension unke pati ya patni ko milti hai.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
text: PM Vishwakarma parampara se kaam karne wale karigaron aur shilpkaron (jaise badhai, lohar, sunar, kumhar, darzi, naai, mochi) ke liye hai. Kul 18 trades covered hain. Umar kam se kam 18 saal ho aur aap haath aur auzaar se swa-rozgar karte ho. Fayde: PM Vishwakarma certificate aur ID card, 5-7 din ki basic training aur 15 din ya zyada ki advanced training (Rs 500 roz ka stipend), modern auzaar ke liye Rs 15,000 ka toolkit incentive, aur bina guarantee ka loan: pehle Rs 1 lakh (18 mahine) aur sahi chukane par doosra Rs 2 lakh (30 mahine), dono sirf 5% byaaj par. Pichhle 5 saal mein aisa hi sarkari self-employment loan na liya ho. Apply pmvishwakarma.gov.in ya CSC centre se hota hai, pehle gram panchayat ya nagar nikay level par verification hota hai. Ye scheme FY 2027-28 tak chalne wali hai.

name: PM SVANidhi (Rehri-Patri Loan)
text: PM SVANidhi shehron mein rehri, thela, patri lagane wale street vendors ke liye bina guarantee ka working capital loan hai. Pehla loan Rs 15,000 (1 saal), time par chukane par doosra Rs 25,000, aur phir teesra Rs 50,000. Samay par repayment par byaaj subsidy aur digital payment par Rs 1,600 tak ka cashback milta hai. Doosra loan chukane ke baad UPI-linked RuPay credit card bhi mil sakta hai. Eligible wo vendor hain jo shahri ilaake mein vending kar rahe hain aur jinke paas nagar nikay (ULB) ka Certificate of Vending ya ID card ya Letter of Recommendation hai. Apply pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in ya bank/CSC se hota hai. Loan sirf tab mana ho sakta hai jab pehle ka koi loan NPA ho. Scheme 31 March 2030 tak chalne wali hai.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
text: Jan Dhan Yojana mein har parivaar ko bank khata milta hai. Khata zero balance se khulta hai, yaani minimum balance rakhna zaroori nahi. Free RuPay debit card milta hai jisme Rs 2 lakh ka accident insurance hota hai (28 August 2018 ke baad khole khate par; claim ke liye accident se pehle 90 din mein card se kam se kam ek transaction hona chahiye). 6 mahine achhe se khata chalane ke baad Rs 10,000 tak overdraft mil sakta hai (ek parivaar mein ek khata, Rs 2000 tak bina sharton ke). Sarkari yojanaon ka paisa (DBT) seedha isi khate mein aata hai, aur pension aur bima yojanayein (PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY) se jud sakte hain. Documents: Aadhaar, voter ID, driving licence, NREGA job card ya PAN mein se koi. Khata kisi bhi bank branch ya Bank Mitra (Banking Correspondent) ke paas khulta hai.

name: e-Shram Card
text: e-Shram card asangathit kshetra ke mazdooron ke liye free pehchan patra hai (jaise construction mazdoor, ghar ka kaam karne wale, rehri wale, migrant mazdoor, auto driver). Eligibility: umar 16 se 59 saal, asangathit kshetra mein kaam, aur EPFO, ESIC ya NPS ka member na ho aur income tax na bharte ho. Card ke saath 12 ank ka Universal Account Number (UAN) milta hai jo poore desh mein chalta hai. 18 se 59 saal ke registered mazdooron ko PMSBY ke tahat Rs 2 lakh ka accident insurance milta hai (maut ya poori viklangta par Rs 2 lakh, aanshik par Rs 1 lakh); pehle saal ka premium sarkar bharti hai, uske baad bank account se chhota annual premium apne aap kat sakta hai. Aage chalkar yehi database baaki sarkari labour yojanaon ke liye use hota hai. Registration eshram.gov.in par Aadhaar aur mobile number (jo Aadhaar se linked ho) aur bank account ke saath khud kar sakte ho, ya CSC centre par. Registration free hai.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Scholarships
text: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) par kendra sarkar ki kai scholarships ek hi jagah milti hain: SC, ST, OBC aur alpsankhyak (minority) vidyarthiyon ke liye pre-matric (school) aur post-matric (class 11 se college) scholarship. Post-matric mein maintenance allowance aur fees ki bharpai milti hai. Parivaar ki saalana aay ki seema scheme ke hisaab se alag hoti hai: SC aur ST post-matric ke liye aam taur par Rs 2.5 lakh, minority post-matric ke liye Rs 2 lakh, aur minority pre-matric ke liye Rs 1 lakh. Aam taur par ek samay par sirf ek sarkari scholarship milti hai. Documents: jaati ya samuday praman patra, aay praman patra, pichhli class ki marksheet, Aadhaar aur bank passbook. Pehle One-Time Registration (OTR) karna hota hai, phir apni scheme chunke form bharna hota hai. 2026-27 ke liye zyadatar scholarships ki aakhri tareekh 31 October 2026 hai. Kuch schemes (jaise NMMS aur kuch renewal) ki date pehle hi nikal chuki hai, isliye apni scheme ki exact date portal par zaroor check karo. State sarkaron ki scholarships alag state portal par hoti hain.

name: Stand-Up India
text: Stand-Up India SC, ST aur mahila udyamiyon ko naya vyapaar shuru karne ke liye bank se Rs 10 lakh se Rs 1 crore tak ka loan dilata hai. Loan sirf greenfield project ke liye hai, yaani pehli baar ka naya business (manufacturing, services, kheti se jude kaam ya trading). Umar 18 saal se zyada, aur kisi bank ya financial institution ka defaulter na ho. Agar company ya partnership hai toh kam se kam 51% hissedari aur control SC, ST ya mahila ke paas ho. Ye composite loan hota hai (term loan aur working capital dono), lautane ke liye 7 saal tak ka time aur zyada se zyada 18 mahine ka moratorium milta hai. Project cost ka kam se kam 10% aapko khud lagana hota hai. Zaroori dhyan: sarkari records mein ye scheme 2025 tak extend hui thi, aur uske baad ka status official taur par confirm nahi hua. Isliye loan ke liye jaane se pehle apne bank branch ya standupmitra.in par pakka kar lo ki scheme abhi chalu hai. Documents: jaati praman (SC/ST ke liye), pehchan aur pate ka praman, project report aur bank ki maangi hui baaki jaankari.
